sector_notes: Monday's rebound was broad but led by industrials and technology, with consumer discretionary and communication services also strong; energy lagged while gold and silver showed relative resilience. Although 3,549 advancers versus 1,205 decliners in the liquid-stock sample confirmed broad participation on November 9, hotter-than-expected U.S. CPI on November 10 pushed S&P 500 and Nasdaq futures lower, and technology and semiconductors remained below their November 4 closes, so treat this as a volatile rebound rather than a confirmed broad risk-on trend.
